subject: environmental-science
title: Renewable Energy: Foundations
welcome_lead: Renewable energy comes from sources that won't run out.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: solar, wind, hydro, geothermal.
final_note: Clean power keeps the lights on without burning the planet.

concepts.def: Energy source that doesn't run out.
Plant or animal waste burnt for energy.

walkthroughs.body_html: Photovoltaic panels turn sunlight into electricity. Solar thermal panels heat water. Even on cloudy days some power is made.
Wind turns big blades that spin a generator. The UK gets a large share of its electricity from offshore wind farms.
Flowing water spins turbines. Hydro dams store water for steady power. Smaller systems work on rivers too.
